description: Get the next step for the user's Himalayas verified badge: whether they are verified, and otherwise the Stripe Identity link (when a check is included, as on Plus or Max) or a US$5 checkout link. Use it when the user wants to get verified: when a check is included, this starts it (a Plus or Max member's included check is then used for 30 days). A passport or national ID also verifies the user's work permit; other IDs verify identity only. get_my_profile shows whether they are verified. The user opens each link and does the ID check or payment on Stripe themselves. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.
name: get_verification_link
title: Get ID verification link
